connect.title: Connect to SEMOSS
connect.description: Enter your SEMOSS server's address, with its module path. You can change it later from File > Change Server.
connect.urlHint: The full address, such as https://semoss.example.com/Monolith.
connect.descriptionSaved: Switch between your saved servers, or add another. Each one keeps its own sign-in.

unreachable.title: Can't reach the server
unreachable.description: {{server}} didn't answer. Retry, or connect to a different server.
unreachable.descriptionNoServer: The server didn't answer. Retry, or connect to a different server.

servers.removeDescription: This signs you out of {{server}} and deletes what this app saved for it on this computer. Your chats stay on the server.
